overview.description: The Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF (MEMS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through investments in small- and mid-cap emerging market companies with perceived sustainable growth potential. MEMS was launched on Jan 10, 2024 and is issued by Matthews.
